home.title: Inventors of the South Tigris Solo Helper
home.play1: Play Inventors of the South Tigris solo against the AI.
home.play2: This application replaces scheme cards and guides you through the game and solo ruleset. It supports all difficulty levels.
home.play3: You can also play with the Era of Experts expansion.

setup.title: Setup
setup.eraOfExpertsDifficultyLevelWarning: When using Era of Experts expansion, you should play on Difficulty Level 4.
setup.eraOfExpertsRoundCountWarning: When using Era of Experts expansion, you should play the shorter 3 rounds version of the game.

difficultyLevel.title: Difficulty Level
difficultyLevel.level2up: 3 additional Silver and 1 more of each influence during Setup
difficultyLevel.level3up: 1 more Dice Scheme card each Round
difficultyLevel.level4up: 1 more Worker Scheme card each Round

instructions.intro: Set up Inventors as you would for a {roundCount}-Round 2-player game, with a few changes. Do not follow the player setup on pages 6-7 for your opponent. Instead, assign them a player colour, giving them only the following items:
instructions.workers: Place their 3 Workers in their player area.
instructions.influence: Place {count} of their Influence into each Guild. Place the rest of their Influence in a Supply nearby.
instructions.tents4Rounds: Place their 4 Tents nearby, and their Ship on the left-most River space of the Main Board.
instructions.tents3RoundsTent1: Place an opponent Tent on the first space of the centre Tent Area, gaining them 1 additional Black Influence immediately.
instructions.tents3Rounds: Place their remaining 3 Tents nearby, and their Ship on the left-most River space of the Main Board.
instructions.publishedDevice3Rounds: Place a Published Device into play with a random Device Card and Neutral Invention Tile. Place your opponent’s Influence to indicate them as the Builder and Publisher.
instructions.shuffleInventionsTiles: Shuffle their Invention Tiles and place them in a facedown Draw Pile.
instructions.reveal3DeviceBoards: Only reveal 3 Device Boards in the first column. For the solo game, there may never be more than 3 Device Boards in each column.
instructions.firstPlayerMaker: Give yourself the First Player Marker.
instructions.noSchemeCards: The AI does not need the scheme cards - the card deck and the AI silver is managed by this application.

preparation.title: The Dummy Player is managed by the application. Preparation:
preparation.ship: Place the Ship of that colour on the left-most space of the River.
preparation.tentInfluence: Also place 1 of the Tents and 12 Influence of that colour in a nearby Supply.

botWorkers.title: AI Worker Supply
botWorkers.instruction: Put {count} Workers into the supply of the AI.

dummyPlayer.title: Dummy Player
dummyPlayer.influence: Place Influence of the Dummy Player’s colour in the indicated Guilds.
dummyPlayer.moveShip: Move the Dummy’s player Ship the indicated number of spaces along the River. Note that it does not collect or reveal Workshop Tiles, and does not skip empty spaces like players do.
dummyPlayer.dummyTokens: Place the indicated Dummy Tokens on their correct spaces. 2 of these will block spaces for this Round, and the other will make 1 of the spaces cost an extra Influence to use.

roundTurnPlayer.title: Player
roundTurnPlayer.playerPaySilver: Silver/Provisions you paid to the AI:
roundTurnPlayer.placeTentConfirm: Do you want to place your tent?
roundTurnPlayer.placeDummyPlayerTent: Place the Dummy Player Tent on an available Tent space.

raiseTents.title: Raise Tents
raiseTents.influence: When the AI raises their Tent, they will gain any Influence they cover.

botTentingAreas.title: Did the AI raise their Tent on either of the right-most Tenting areas?
botTentingAreas.space4Result: The AI gets 1 more Worker Scheme Card next Round (managed by the application).
botTentingAreas.space5Result: The AI gets 1 more Dice Scheme Card next Round (managed by the application).
botTentingAreas.notSelected: Please select the AI's tenting space.

general.silverCost: The action is only possible if the AI can spend the indicated amount of Silver (managed by the application).
general.influenceCost: The action is only possible if the AI can spend the indicated Influence.
general.influenceBonus: The AI places the indicated influence on Guild(s).
general.silverBonus: The AI gains the indicated amount of silver (managed by the application).
general.workerPlacement: The action is only possible, it the AI can place a worker on one of the indicated spaces (in order of preference).
general.workerPlacementGuild: The action is only possible, it the AI can place a worker on one of the spaces below the indicated guild (priority is left, right, bottom space).

invent.title: Invent
invent.chooseDevice: Your opponent will use their number focus to Invent a particular Device.
invent.deviceCard: If there is a Device Board available, turn over the top Device Card from the Draw Pile. If placing it would create at least 1 Influence match, place it on that Device Board. If not, discard it and reveal a new Device Card. Keep doing this until there is at least 1 match.
invent.gainInfluence: After placing the Device Card, your opponent gains 1 Influence for each match. Take the top Invention Tile from their Draw Pile and place it on the Device. They ignore all other costs and effects that players are usually concerned with.

build.title: Build
build.buildDevice: Your opponent will use their number focus to Build a previously Invented Device.
build.turnOverTile: Turn over and move the Invention Tile as normal. If it was your Invention Tile, you still gain the effect. Place their Influence on the Builder slot of the Device Board, and move it into the highest possible row of the next column.

publish.title: Publish
publish.publishDevice: Your opponent will use their number focus to Publish a previously Built Device. If you were the Inventor, gain 1 Silver from the Main Supply.
publish.moveDeviceBoard: Place their Influence on the Publisher slot of the Device Board, and move it into the highest possible row of the next column. Do not slide other Built Devices up if spaces appear above them.

test.title: Test
test.chooseDie: Your opponent will use their colour focus to decide what colour Die to place. If there are no spaces on Built and Published Devices of that colour, they will look for their next colour preference.
test.chooseDeviceBoard: Use their number preference to determine which row they will place the coloured Die in. If there is 1 or more available space in that row, they will place it on the left-most Built or Published Device in that row.
test.rollDie: Take the coloured Die from the Main Supply and roll it. Place it on the indicated Device Board (it does not matter if the rolled number was lower than other Dice on that Device Board).
test.gainInfluenceAdvanceShip: If the Die covers an Influence icon, your opponent gains 1 Influence of that colour. Move their Ship the indicated number of spaces, following the same movement rules as you would.
test.workshopTile: If they stop at a space with a Workshop Tile, place it facedown in their Supply for end-game scoring.

research.title: Research

researchSpaces.title: When Researching, they will only carry this out on spaces that are completely empty - no Workshop Tiles or Research Tile. They will always prioritise spaces in the following order:
researchSpaces.currentSection: The left-most empty space within the River section where their Ship rests, but not to the right of their Ship.
researchSpaces.previousSection: The left-most empty space in the River section to the left of the section where their Ship rests.
researchSpaces.entireRiver: The left-most empty space on the entire River, even if this is to the right of their Ship.

research.researchTile: After selecting a space, place their Influence on the left Influence slot. Reveal the top Research Tile from that River section’s Draw pile, and place it faceup on that space. They ignore all icons on Research Tiles.

advanceShip.title: Advance Ship
advanceShip.moveShip: Move their Ship 1 space, following the same movement rules as you would.

addDiceReserveCard.title: Add Dice Reserve Card
addDiceReserveCard.instruction: Your opponent will shuffle the top Dice Scheme Card from the Reserve Pile into their Draw Pile (managed by the application).

tent.title: Place Tent
tent.placeTent: The brown Tent icon shows where they want to place their Tent in reference to the 5 spaces of the Main Board. If that space is blocked, they take the next space to the right, wrapping back around to the left if needed.
tent.dummyPlayerTent: The white Tent icon shows where they will place the Dummy Player’s Tent.
